current_mission: Use Tony's latest real worksheet photos to improve confident two-digit OCR reads without allowing confident wrong reads.

next_best_move: Codex/Tony: push and test build 2026.06.07-0959-EDT-sg3-live-ocr-safety on more live phone scans. plain_english_status: The current app has a pushed review-gate fix at commit 588425b that stopped a recent iPhone batch from blanket-marking almost every answer as low confidence. Tony then supplied a newer 9-photo worksheet batch and set the next target: at least 95% confident reads with 100% accuracy on those confident reads. The current source-aware policy reads all 90 handwritten answers correctly on the active 9-photo replay and auto-clears 89/90 answers with 89/89 confident accuracy and 0 confident wrong reads. Tony's 2026-06-07 live iPhone batch exposed the opposite risk: the old public build was overconfident, with 18 confident wrong answers. The current live-safety build improves OCR truth to 72/90 and keeps confident reads at 53/53 with 0 confident wrong answers, so rough live captures are safer but still conservative.

cards.title: Harden live iPhone OCR
cards.summary: Current live iPhone result is 53/90 confident reads, 53/53 confident accuracy, 0 confident wrong reads, and 72/90 OCR-correct answers.
cards.detail: The clean 9-photo target is still met at 89/90 confident with 0 confident wrong reads. The live phone batch is the harder next frontier: improve crop quality, preprocessing, or model signal before broadening confidence gates.

cards.title: Send more student sheets when convenient
cards.summary: More real completed A/B/C sheets will make OCR tuning less likely to overfit one student or one photo.
cards.detail: Good enough: full page visible, corners included, not badly blurred. Perfect lighting is not required. If a live app scan fails, a normal camera photo of the same page helps separate capture issues from OCR recognition.

cards.title: Patch only with truth-score replay
cards.summary: Use npm run score:sg3-ocr and npm run score:live-ocr-truth after every OCR/review change.
cards.detail: The clean benchmark is private-evidence/sg3-9-photo-confidence-20260606/candidate-source-aware-confidence-2-20260607. The live benchmark is private-evidence/sg3-iphone-live-20260607/current-build-0959. A patch only counts as progress if confident wrong answers stay at 0 and handwritten-truth accuracy or safe confident coverage improves on new evidence.

cards.title: Do not tune OCR blind
cards.summary: OCR/capture changes should wait for real sample evidence or a reproducible failing test.
cards.detail: This protects the currently promising MacBook/upload behavior and avoids overfitting to imagined problems.

cards.title: Decide pilot threshold
cards.summary: After real samples are tested, decide what is good enough for a small classroom pilot.
cards.detail: This should be based on scan success rate, retry behavior, and teacher-review usefulness.

cards.title: Shape-rescue OCR candidate verified
cards.summary: The current SG3 OCR candidate has zero confident wrong reads and 90/90 OCR-correct answers on the 9-photo handwritten-truth benchmark.
cards.detail: Shape rescues improved recognition from 79/90 to 90/90 while keeping rescued uncertain digits under review. Current best result: 49/90 confident answers, 49/49 correct confident answers, 0 confident wrong answers, 90/90 total OCR-correct answers. Recognition is now clean on this batch, but confidence coverage does not yet meet the 95% target.

cards.title: Confidence calibration report added
cards.summary: SG3 now has a repeatable report showing why the app is under-confident and why broad threshold loosening is not enough.
cards.detail: Report: private-evidence/sg3-9-photo-confidence-20260606/candidate-four-from-one-rescues/confidence-calibration.md. It shows 41 reviewed answers, all 41 reviewed answers OCR-correct, and a target requirement of 86/90 confident reads. Moderate confidence-only promotion reaches 54/90; evidence-only reason promotion plus moderate no-reason mismatch reaches 88/90 but is not yet a safe production policy because it would trust fragile low-probability rescues.

cards.title: 9-photo OCR recognition cleaned up
cards.summary: The active 9-photo replay now reads every handwritten answer correctly while preserving zero confident wrong reads.
cards.detail: Latest best run: private-evidence/sg3-9-photo-confidence-20260606/candidate-four-from-one-rescues. Result: 90/90 answer OCR accuracy, 180/180 digit OCR accuracy, 49/90 confident answers, 49/49 confident accuracy, and 0 confident wrong answers. The next challenge is confidence policy, not the two former 4-to-1 recognition misses.
